title: Watchmen
description: Alan Moore and Dave Gibbons' genre-defining deconstruction of vigilante psychology, nuclear dread, and moral compromise in a dystopian Cold War America.

title: Batman: The Dark Knight Returns
description: Frank Miller's gritty masterpiece depicting an aging Bruce Wayne coming out of ten-year retirement to reclaim a decayed Gotham City from the Mutants and the Joker.

title: Invincible
description: Robert Kirkman and Cory Walker create Mark Grayson's coming-of-age journey, featuring high-consequence visceral battles and shocking Viltrumite revelations.

title: Spider-Man: Kraven's Last Hunt
description: J.M. DeMatteis and Mike Zeck's haunting psychological thriller where Kraven the Hunter defeats Spider-Man, buries him alive, and steals his identity.

title: Hellboy: Seed of Destruction
description: Mike Mignola's signature chiaroscuro art style introduces the Right Hand of Doom, Nazi occultists, and the Bureau for Paranormal Research and Defense.

title: Saga
description: Brian K. Vaughan and Fiona Staples craft an interstellar odyssey following star-crossed lovers Alana and Marko as they protect their daughter across warring galaxies.

title: The Sandman: Preludes & Nocturnes
description: Neil Gaiman's magnum opus chronicling Morpheus, the Lord of Dreams, escaping seventy years of human imprisonment to rebuild his shattered realm of the Dreaming.

title: V for Vendetta
description: A masked anarchist waging asymmetrical warfare against a fascist totalitarian government in a near-future United Kingdom.

title: Batman: Year One
description: Frank Miller and David Mazzucchelli redefine the parallel beginnings of rookie vigilante Bruce Wayne and honest detective Jim Gordon.

title: All-Star Superman
description: Grant Morrison and Frank Quitely present Superman's final labors as he faces cellular overexposure to solar radiation, completing legendary heroic feats.

title: Daredevil: Born Again
description: When Matt Murdock's secret identity is sold to the Kingpin, Wilson Fisk systematically strips Daredevil of his sanity, home, and legal career.

title: Spider-Man: Into the Spider-Verse Canon
description: Dan Slott unites every alternate Spider-hero across the multiverse to wage war against the predatory Inheritors who feast on spider-totems.
